title: How Local Are You To This?!
about: Hot spots from our own lists, the most iconic first. Each entry is the id of the spot's first post in posts.json; its series post is series-<that id>. A spot that first ran in a 1 vs 1 post is listed as <post id>/<slug of the place name> (lowercase, apostrophes dropped, other non-letters as hyphens) and its series post is series-<post id>-<slug>. A spot is done once posts.json has its series post.
